_comment: Expected per-image outcome for a WELL-PROVISIONED server (the default docker run, ~2 GB). Any file NOT listed defaults to 'ok' (dither to <=6 palette colours). 'reject' = refused at upload; 'fail' = accepted but render FAILED. The decode budget scales with the memory budget (resource_budget.py), so a roomy server renders the 38.9 MP Albi panorama; only the 100 MP synth bomb is refused. For a memory-constrained run pass expectations-constrained.json.

synth_black_10000x10000.png.reason: 100 MP > 40 MP upload cap (decompression-bomb guard) — refused at upload regardless of memory budget
